Organizer: Interastral Peace Entertainment — Business Outsourcing Project Team
Preface: Bridging micro-needs with flexible talent to build a thriving and efficient Astropolis together.

Welcome to the current issue of Gig Weekly! We're dedicated to making non-core, low-risk, and fun missions available to every lively citizen of Astropolis. In the spirit of efficiency, the publication uses a "sealed-bid low-cost auction" model to fill all positions: When recruitment closes, the bidder offering the lowest permissible bid walks away with the job contract.

We believe that market self-regulation will yield fair labor pricing and a pleasant working experience. Please browse the following selected opportunities, bid rationally, and compete in an orderly fashion. Best of luck with your bidding!

Featured Positions:
1. Background Actor
Posted by: Wondrous Tales of Astropolis Artist Management
Description: Participate in the filming of Season 4 of the sitcom Wondrous Tales of Astropolis, performing non-speaking walk-on roles and reaction shots as directed.
Requirements: Must follow on-set instructions. Prior performance experience preferred.

2. Columnist
Posted by: Interastral Peace Entertainment – Business Outsourcing Project Team
Description: Interview outstanding employees at Interastral Peace Entertainment and write promotional pieces for the IPC's intranet, highlighting each employee's team contributions and professional dedication.
Requirements: Must have experience in non-fiction writing, and a specialist at distilling and embellishing information. All final copyrights belong to the poster.

3. "Universal Companion Service Robot" Prototype Tester
Posted by: Interastral Peace Entertainment – Business Outsourcing Project Team
Description: Engage the latest generation "Universal Companion Service Robot" in extensive conversation, listen to its full repertoire of 5,000 pre-loaded dad jokes, and provide detailed feedback on each and every one.
Requirements: Calm and patient disposition required. Recent mental health evaluation report must be provided.

4. Promotion Assistant
Posted by: "Curious Flavors" Theme Restaurant
Description: Dress in Xianzhou-style attire and engage in interactive promotions at Astropolis Commercial Plaza, attract customers, and distribute discount vouchers.
Requirements: Tall stature, energetic, and an approachable personality.

5. Resident Singer
Posted by: "Rusty" Tavern
Description: Perform live vocal and instrumental sets at the tavern each evening to create an elegant atmosphere, and take song requests from guests.
Requirements: Must provide own instrument and performance attire. Must have a distinctive and captivating voice, and adeptly perform current trending songs in Astropolis.

6. Director for Project Risk Buffering
Posted by: Anonymous (identity revealed upon selection)
Description: Serve as the Partnership Director for a designated project. Duties involve signing your name on a series of process documents, meeting minutes, and approval reports.
Requirements: Must be able to write your own name, and handwriting is legible.
